description: Archive one Gmail message: it leaves the inbox but stays in All Mail, fully recoverable. Use only when the user asked for the archive; confirm first if it's your own suggestion. Only works on mailboxes connected under a legacy modify grant; current connections are read-only and cannot change the mailbox; the tool says so if not.

account.description: Email address of the connected mailbox holding the message. Omit to try all connected mailboxes.

message_id.description: The Gmail message id to archive.

name: archive_gmail_message
title: Archive email
